name: Image to 3D (TripoSR, toon cutout + framing)
description: Single concept image -> BiRefNet_toonout cutout on 50% grey -> crop to object with margin -> padded 1024 square -> TripoSR mesh. Saves the framed square (use it to camera-project the concept onto the mesh: TripoSR input camera = +X, distance 1.9, vertical FOV 40 deg, Z up after Blender's default OBJ import). Output OBJ carries per-vertex colour; no UVs, no texture. Hard-surface detail is soft (marching cubes at PARAM_INT_RESOLUTION). Built for Soapbox-2D K-09 kart parts.

image_path.description: Concept image filename in ComfyUI/input (object on a plain light background)

padding.description: Margin in pixels around the cutout bbox before squaring (96 on a 1024 concept ~= TripoSR's preferred 0.85 foreground ratio)

output_prefix.description: Filename prefix for the saved framed input
